scope: Bounded independent final review of the newer recovered local working tree: durable wear/Favorites/preferences, backup and modal lifetimes, delayed rejection exposure and final caller repairs. This does not replace final browser or live-publication gates.

reviewed_files.review: Complete store source: validation, durable read/export, revision and raw-token guards, Web Locks queue, import preview identity and restore.
Complete store source: validated exact identity, duplicate-save behavior, merge preview binding, cross-tab refresh, failed persistence and recoverable raw export.

Persistent-store region and current call contract: comparisons/context validation, durable tokens, private preview tickets, merge/Undo/toggle, exclusive writes and export; numerical fitting policy unchanged.
Complete source: captured pair context, latest-file preview, modal lifecycle before/after queue acquisition, feedback checks around rendering/voting, and current export.

All active wear/Favorites mutation callers, backup import/export, preference host boundary, storage listeners and the repaired postcommit continuations; full application review is assigned to app_final_review.
Captured exact selection/context and final rejection gate for exchange packet/download, backed by existing real-handler regressions.

confirmed_findings.before: Each real handler checked the initiating modal inside the write lock, but unconditionally dismissed the current modal after awaiting lock-promise settlement. A newer dialog opened after the successful write could therefore be closed; an old restored session could also be applied over newer work.

before_probe.kind: Actual production function extraction with a controlled exclusive-store callback/settlement boundary

confirmed_findings.repair: Retain the real committed write and invalidate/refresh affected data. Dismiss or publish the originating action message only while that modal still owns the action. Keep newer log transactions and backup previews. Apply a restored session only while the original confirmation remains current, with subsequent render generation/modal-epoch guards.

independent_regression.scope: Three actual application handlers, each with same-panel, newer-panel/current-outfit, and closed-panel continuations. Uses the actual local-state store with an in-memory backing record and a controlled Web Locks implementation that defers only promise settlement after the real commit. Checks exact once-only durable write/revision/record outcome, normal success, preserved newer UI/selection, and required history/recommendation refresh.

active_caller_review: All active wear/session mutations found in the current application call store.exclusive before saveSession/addEvent/restore. Callbacks recheck generation, source history or modal ownership as applicable.
All active Favorites add/remove/import mutations use favorites.exclusive with captured modal and original selection or preview.
Preference mutation callers use learning.exclusive and captured modal/pair context; votes recheck saved rejection state after acquiring their lock and after asynchronous feedback synchronization.
Backing-store comparison and private preview identity remain separate protections: refreshing/exporting cannot bless an older reviewed import payload.
Readable corrupt wear/Favorites bytes remain recoverable via export; unreadable backing storage does not produce a claimed empty backup.
Storage listeners include actual key removal and key===null clear events; store refresh remains read-only.
Favorites and wear history remain historical data when an outfit later becomes rejected; current display/selection/export has separate rejection gates. No historical record is silently rewritten.
